question: Should Crabbox accept the USB-passthrough and macOS VNC double-click features as supported product surface, or should this PR be narrowed to random clone serials?
rationale: Those two additions create independent operator behavior and, for USB passthrough, a physical-device access boundary that cannot be accepted merely as incidental implementation detail for serial randomization.

options.title: Narrow to random serials
options.body: Keep only the opt-in serial-generation capability and its focused configuration, documentation, tests, and live Tart proof; submit the other two capabilities separately.

options.title: Sponsor all three features
options.body: Explicitly accept the broader direction, then require separate runtime proof and documented operating/security expectations for USB passthrough and VNC double-clicking.

recommendation.title: Narrow to random serials
recommendation.body: Keep only the opt-in serial-generation capability and its focused configuration, documentation, tests, and live Tart proof; submit the other two capabilities separately.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main Tart feature-history owner was available in the supplied review evidence.
